title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a colour-blind-safe palette to the junction picture
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 app draws green, amber and red lights; some colour-blind users cannot tell them apart.

## Context
Accessibility is part of the quality checklist (QUALITY.md, item 9).

## Expected outcome
Lights that stay distinguishable (for example by shape or a text label), in light and dark mode.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/app.html`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Each light state recognisable without colour
- [ ] Screenshot added to the pull request

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add the random delay term to Session 2
body:
## Problem
The uniform delay of Session 2 is 29 percent below the simulated delay at x = 0.89 because random arrivals are not modelled.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`, milestone 1.

## Expected outcome
A function for the total average delay with a random term, a figure comparing it with the simulator, and a checkpoint.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-02/lesson.py`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Within 15 percent of the simulation for x between 0.5 and 0.9
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add a minimum-green and maximum-green explorer to the actuated rule
body:
## Problem
The actuated rule in Session 3 has fixed limits of 8 s and 45 s; students cannot see what they do.

## Context
The limits control the trade-off between responsiveness and stability.

## Expected outcome
A small experiment script and figure that sweeps the limits and reports delay and largest queue.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Sweep over at least 4 values of each limit, 12 seeds each
- [ ] Short write-up of what you found

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: adaptive timing for a swinging rush hour
body:
## Problem
The Target animation shows an adaptive controller beating a fixed plan when the busy direction swaps; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Average delay at least 15 percent below the shipped actuated rule in the swinging-demand test
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
